Daily Devotional

May 21

11 Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore. (Psalms 16:11 KJV)

David said these things because he had put God first in his life (Psalms 16:8). God has said He would never leave us (Hebrews 13:5), so if you are not experiencing the joy and pleasures of the Christian life, it is because you have not put God first in your life. To enjoy the benefits of being a Christian, you must stay focused on God, by keeping in His Word (Romans 12:2) and keeping Him in your thoughts continually. That is the only way you will experience the fullness of the Christian life and the peace that it brings (Isaiah 26:3).

Peter quoted Psalms 16:8-11 in Acts 2:25-28, and put it in the past tense to show that God had already given him the fullness of joy and all the pleasures that come with knowing God. If you are born again as a Christian, you need to get in the Word of God, and get to know God to the degree that you walk in the fullness of the life that God has given us. If you are not a Christian, then you need to get saved and born again in the spirit (Romans 10:9-10), so that you can enjoy all the benefits that God gives to His children. Thank you Lord for all you have done!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
